title: 'Waves of displaced' arriving in Lebanon's Sidon as Israel warns of new strikes
summary: France 24's Catherine Norris Trent reports from Lebanon's Sidon, where she says waves of displaced people have been arriving as they head further north in an effort to escape Israeli strikes.
